subtitle: Roles, responsibilities, and the impact delivered along the way.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
experiences.description: Designed distributed financial-services microservices using Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and REST APIs, to modernize account and transaction-processing workflows, improving service scalability and giving engineering teams independently deployable business capabilities. Developed an AI-assisted financial intelligence solution using Python, OpenAI APIs, LLMs, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), to ground responses in approved enterprise knowledge, helping analysts and operations teams retrieve relevant financial information with greater consistency. Built agentic AI workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, and Claude AI, to coordinate specialized agents for document analysis, financial data interpretation, and operational assistance, reducing repetitive analysis for internal business users while maintaining controlled enterprise workflows. Engineered machine learning pipelines with Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn, to prepare, train, evaluate, and operationalize predictive models, supporting financial risk and forecasting use cases for analytics and business teams. Containerized application and AI services with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS, using AWS Lambda and Amazon S3 for event-driven and serverless workloads, enabling scalable deployment patterns across development and production environments. Implemented Apache Kafka event streams and Redis caching for distributed services, to support asynchronous processing and faster access to frequently used data, helping customer-facing applications handle high-volume financial workflows reliably. Automated software delivery and production operations through Jenkins CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and MLOps practices, reducing manual release activities and giving engineering teams a consistent path for deploying application and machine learning changes.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
experiences.description: Developed Java and Spring Boot microservices for digital-payment and transaction-processing workflows, to separate core payment capabilities into independently deployable services, improving maintainability and enabling engineering teams to evolve customer transaction journeys safely. Implemented RESTful APIs using Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, JDBC, and SQL, to validate and process payment-service requests, strengthening transaction integrity and supporting reliable customer-facing financial workflows. Built Apache Kafka event-processing workflows for payment and notification events, to decouple distributed services and support asynchronous processing of more than 5,000 events per minute, enabling timely downstream processing for payment operations. Optimized payment-service performance using Redis caching and SQL query tuning, to reduce repeated database access and improve API responsiveness, supporting faster transaction and checkout experiences for digital-payment customers. Applied Python, Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn to early machine learning initiatives, to analyze transaction and behavioral data and develop predictive signals, providing analytics teams with data-driven inputs for fraud and customer-risk analysis. Deployed Java services using Docker and AWS-based infrastructure, to standardize application environments and simplify deployments, helping development and operations teams maintain consistent service releases across environments. Strengthened application quality with JUnit, Mockito, integration testing, and Jenkins CI/CD, to automate service validation and release checks, reducing regression risk and improving deployment confidence for payment engineering teams.

experiences.title: Software Developer
experiences.description: Developed Java and Spring Boot backend services for enterprise applications, to implement modular business workflows and RESTful APIs, delivering maintainable application components for client-facing and internal business users. Engineered performance-sensitive components using C++ and STL, to process computational business logic and data transformations efficiently, supporting applications that required reliable low-level processing and responsive execution. Built interactive web interfaces using JavaScript, Angular, HTML5, and CSS3, to connect customer workflows with backend services, delivering reusable screens and responsive functionality for business users. Integrated relational databases through JDBC and SQL, to persist transactional and application data consistently, supporting reporting and business workflows while maintaining reliable data-access patterns. Introduced Docker-based development environments, to standardize application dependencies and runtime configurations, helping developers reproduce application behavior consistently across local and testing environments. Configured Jenkins and Git-based development workflows, to automate builds and establish repeatable delivery practices, improving release consistency between development and QA teams. Implemented unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito, to validate business logic and service interactions before deployment, improving application reliability and reducing defects during downstream testing.
